title: Sentinel Body Intelligence Methodology v1
data_environment_variable: DATA_NETWORK (mainnet | testnet; default mainnet observation). Flip to testnet if hackathon rules require all-testnet data; indices become thin and the Sentinel Fleet cohort carries the Health Index.

snapshot.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JCS (stable stringify) then SHA-256 hex, 64 lowercase hex chars
snapshot.note: Only the canonicalized snapshot body is hashed. Off-chain proof metadata (tx hash, retrieval time) is deliberately outside the hash so the commitment can be attached afterwards.

capital_flow.name: Selected native NEAR balance-change comparison
capital_flow.method: Per cohort and asset: balance_now - balance_at_reference. Reference = the agent's previous real snapshot (default, no archival needed) or a pinned block_id when within the verified 86,400-block window.
capital_flow.usd_conversion: Separately dated provider price; not a guaranteed end-of-block price.
capital_flow.visual: Full-width magnitude grouping; bands are NOT traced transfers. Current /chain-evidence native deltas use integer subtraction; legacy archived deltas used Number arithmetic.

cost_model.name: Builder Cost-of-Living Calculator
cost_model.near_gas: gas = avgTgasPerTx * 1e12; cost_NEAR = gas * gas_price_yocto / 1e24; USD = cost_NEAR * near_usd
cost_model.near_storage: locked_capital_NEAR = storage_MB * 1e6 * storage_amount_per_byte_yocto / 1e24. Storage is LOCKED capital, not spent, and is shown separately.
cost_model.comparison: AUD01 recurring estimates include the same AI and hosting plan for each chain. EVM uses source gasPrice and assumed gas units; unmodelled Base L1/priority costs remain excluded. Solana uses source base fee and assumed signatures; rent reserve excluded from recurring total.
cost_model.cost_per_1000_actions: monthly_total_usd / (actionsPerMonth / 1000), with utilization included in actionsPerMonth

agent_health.name: Legacy Sentinel fleet custom model (not official health)
agent_health.normalization: Fixed bounds below. NEVER data-adaptive, so a historical number stays reproducible.

components.unit: agents represented in last two retained commitments; not a 24h census
fractional change in fleet count against previous saved fleet; absent baseline defaulted to raw 0 (normalized 50)
fractional change in fleet balance against previous saved fleet; absent baseline defaulted to raw 0 (normalized 50)
HHI of cohort balances; inverted (1-HHI) so lower concentration is healthier
same publisher-share proxy as fleet_liveness; NOT measured repeat-user retention
share of sampled Sentinel agents appearing in last two retained report entries; not two time windows

agent_health.confidence: Custom checklist: 0.6 if fleet nonempty + 0.2 if any retained commitment + 0.2 if previous fleet available; confidence = checklist * (0.6 if stale else 1). Not statistical confidence.
agent_health.what_this_is_not: Not a price signal, not an investment metric, not a census of all agents, and not ground truth about account identity. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.

audit_notes.revision: AUD01 display/methodology clarification; committed snapshot bytes unchanged
audit_notes.current_chain_evidence: /chain-evidence: exact 1200-block native NEAR comparison with all amounts pinned to two returned hashes; actual elapsed timestamps and raw responses retained
audit_notes.legacy_snapshot: Historical hash integrity is independently checkable; not all original later state reads retained their returned block refs
audit_notes.confidence: Legacy health confidence/coverage are custom checklist weights, not statistical probabilities or network coverage
